say:2:1711149402:0.text: You conveyed the contents of the will to the court magicians, who each discovered suspicious points.
say:2:1711149402:0.source_cn: 你将遗嘱上的内容转达给了宫廷魔法师们，他们也各自发现了疑点。

say:4:1711149403:1.text: This will is somewhat illogical and temporally inconsistent...
say:4:1711149403:1.source_cn: 这遗嘱在逻辑和时态上有些说不通……

say:9:1711149407:1.text: Wait a minute! Cake! Wine! I knew something was off!
say:9:1711149407:1.source_cn: 等等！蛋糕！葡萄酒！我刚才就觉得哪里不对劲！

say:11:1711149409:1.text: It's like... someone meticulously maintains and "feeds" it every day!
say:11:1711149409:1.source_cn: 就好像……每天都有人去精心维护和“进食”一样！

say:13:1711149410:1.text: You list all the doubts surrounding Kraft's "death" in your mind...
say:13:1711149410:1.source_cn: 你将关于克拉夫特“死亡”的疑点在脑海中全部列出……
